# documents

A document register on top of existing records: captured files, expiry dates and per-record visibility.

## README

# Documents

A document register on top of existing records: captured files with a category, linked to records, visible only to whoever may read those records.

## What it shows

- `createDocumentsFeature` (`@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/documents`) with `categories`, `linkTargets` and `access` roles.
- A `capture` rule turns a file field into a document source without the entity knowing about the documents feature: every saved `contract.file` is filed as a document of category `contract`, titled from the row, and linked to the contract's property.
- Visibility follows the linked records: a document is visible to users who may read the linked records and the contract that owns the file. The `documents:query:for-record` query returns the documents of one record; a property reader sees none for the property because they may not read the contract that owns the file.

### src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import {
  createFilesFeature,
  createInMemoryFileProvider,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/files";
import { createTestUser, testTenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import {
  buildMultipartBody,
  patchFileInstanceofForBunTest,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/helpers";
import { setupTestStack, type TestStack } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import * as z from "zod";
import { documents, propertyManagement } from "../feature.ts";

const tenant = testTenantId(1);
const admin = createTestUser({ id: 1, tenantId: tenant, roles: ["TenantAdmin"] });
const propertyReader = createTestUser({ id: 2, tenantId: tenant, roles: ["PropertyReader"] });
const contractReader = createTestUser({ id: 3, tenantId: tenant, roles: ["ContractReader"] });

type Page = { rows: readonly { title: string }[] };

let stack: TestStack;

beforeAll(async () => {
  patchFileInstanceofForBunTest();
  stack = await setupTestStack({
    features: [createFilesFeature(), propertyManagement, documents],
    files: { storageProvider: createInMemoryFileProvider() },
  });
});
afterAll(() => stack.cleanup());

async function uploadContractFile(): Promise<string> {
  const form = new FormData();
  form.append("entityType", "contract");
  form.append("fieldName", "file");
  form.append(
    "file",
    new File([Buffer.from("%PDF-1.4 lease")], "lease.pdf", { type: "application/pdf" }),
  );
  const { body, contentType } = await buildMultipartBody(form);
  const res = await stack.app.request("/api/files", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${await stack.jwt.sign(admin)}`,
      "Content-Type": contentType,
    },
    body,
  });
  return z.object({ id: z.string() }).parse(await res.json()).id;
}

describe("documents recipe", () => {
  test("a contract file becomes a document that only contract readers see", async () => {
    const property = await stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
      "property-management:write:property:create",
      { name: "Main street 1" },
      admin,
    );
    const contract = await stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
      "property-management:write:contract:create",
      { name: "C-1", propertyId: property.id, file: await uploadContractFile() },
      admin,
    );

    const forRecord = (as: typeof admin, entityType: string, entityId: string) =>
      stack.http.queryOk<Page>("documents:query:for-record", { entityType, entityId }, as);

    expect(
      (await forRecord(contractReader, "contract", contract.id)).rows.map((r) => r.title),
    ).toEqual(["Contract C-1"]);
    expect((await forRecord(admin, "property", property.id)).rows.map((r) => r.title)).toEqual([
      "Contract C-1",
    ]);
    // the property reader may open the property but not the contract that owns the file
    expect((await forRecord(propertyReader, "property", property.id)).rows).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// kumiko-feature-version: 1
// Documents Sample
//
// A `contract` entity with a file field becomes a document source without knowing about the
// documents feature: the capture rule below files every saved contract file as a document of
// category "contract" and links it to the contract and to its property. Who sees the document
// follows from who may read the linked records and the contract that owns the file.

import { createDocumentsFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/documents";
import {
  createEntity,
  createFileField,
  createTextField,
  defineEntityCreateHandler,
  defineEntityDetailHandler,
  defineEntityListHandler,
  defineEntityUpdateHandler,
  defineFeature,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";

const text = () =>
  createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true, maxLength: 120 });

export const propertyEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_sample_documents_properties",
  fields: { name: text() },
  access: { read: { PropertyReader: "all", TenantAdmin: "all" } },
});

export const contractEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_sample_documents_contracts",
  fields: { name: text(), propertyId: text(), file: createFileField() },
  access: { read: { ContractReader: "all", TenantAdmin: "all" } },
});

const access = { roles: ["PropertyReader", "ContractReader", "TenantAdmin"] };

export const propertyManagement = defineFeature("property-management", (r) => {
  r.requires({ features: ["files", "documents"] });
  r.entity({ name: "property", ...propertyEntity });
  r.entity({ name: "contract", ...contractEntity });
  for (const [name, entity] of [
    ["property", propertyEntity],
    ["contract", contractEntity],
  ] as const) {
    r.writeHandler(defineEntityCreateHandler(name, entity, { access }));
    r.writeHandler(defineEntityUpdateHandler(name, entity, { access: { roles: ["TenantAdmin"] } }));
    r.queryHandler(defineEntityListHandler(name, entity, { access }));
    r.queryHandler(defineEntityDetailHandler(name, entity, { access }));
  }
});

export const documents = createDocumentsFeature({
  categories: ["contract", "insurance"],
  linkTargets: ["property", "contract"],
  access,
  capture: [
    {
      entity: "contract",
      field: "file",
      category: "contract",
      title: (row) => `Contract ${String(row["name"])}`,
      links: (row) => [{ entityType: "property", entityId: String(row["propertyId"]) }],
    },
  ],
});
```
